name: San Diego Cruise
author: prodrive-ac-builder
_about: Open-world FREEROAM cruise of Kevin's childhood neighborhood (Del Cerro / San Carlos / Allied Gardens / La Mesa), built by MERGING two Google My Maps 'Directions' exports into one drivable road network. Keeps the I-8 / SR-125 freeways. Not a circuit - drive anywhere. Vibe over realism: bright SoCal golden hour, SRP-style freeway furniture, California-highway palms on the surface streets, Lake Murray as water.

location._anchor: 5602 Dartford Way (Del Cerro) - childhood home; AC_START placed here.

source._doc: kml-network = merge N My Maps 'Directions' KML/KMZ exports into ONE deduped road graph (scripts/gps/network.py), not a single ordered loop. Each file's LineStrings are road-snapped by Google; we snap shared streets together into a node-edge network.

network._doc: Graph-build + per-class road knobs read by scripts/gps/network.py and the network mesh stage.

scenery._doc: Per-class scatter for the freeroam. Freeway edges get SRP-style furniture (barriers/gantries/lightpoles); surface streets get California-highway palms + dry SoCal flora. corridor_margin_m keeps scatter clear of every road edge.

lake_murray._doc: Water plane for Lake Murray (filled at the SW edge of the network, by Cowles Mtn Blvd / Kiowa).

viaduct._doc: Elevated freeway deck (SRP/Shutoko look). base_lift_m = constant deck height even over flat ground (tapered to grade at junctions so ramps connect); the bridge component adds more over canyon dips. Crank base_lift_m + smooth_win for taller decks.

terrain._doc: Override the terrain-grid bbox so real peaks + the coast are inside the map: Cowles Mtn (N), Mt Helix (E), the Pacific (W). Per-edge road elevation is unchanged; only the surrounding ground grid extends. [s, w, n, e].

ocean._doc: Distant Pacific backdrop to the real WEST: a flat sea-level water plane from the coast out to the horizon. Sea level is elevation 0 (the DEM dives to it at the coast).

layouts._doc: Single freeroam layout over the whole merged network. AC_START at the childhood home (5602 Dartford Way). No lap timing required - it's a cruise.

light_pollution._note: San Diego metro sky glow - broad, warm-white, faint
